description: Different model profiles should preserve project-aware plan item identity and complete adapter coverage for a polyglot repository.

lockedFields.reason: Project planning must preserve complete audit coverage once all fixture roots have registered adapters.
The Kotlin, Python, and web projects each contribute one plan item in this fixture.
The Kotlin calculator, Python parser, and web session client are untested candidates that become add-test items.
Flattened plan items must preserve their owning project root.
Project item IDs are the stable cross-project reference for future generation.
The candidate remains an add-test action until test evidence changes.
Project plan artifacts must retain the repo-native verification command for the owning project.
The Python project item must remain visible in project planning output.
